audit.why: Six of seven rows disagreed. win[] matches packet.levelChart, and it also matches the content whys, which describe Ziggs owning levels 1-2 outright and Annie taking over from 4.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] attributes Ziggs' level 1 dominance to 'longer auto-poke range'. Short Fuse's auto-attack tell and Hexplosive Minefield's role were never mentioned; Satchel Charge was described only as an escape.
audit.why: Ziggs' basic attack range is shorter than Annie's 625 Q — he does not out-auto her. What beats her is Bouncing Bomb at 850. Short Fuse periodically empowers his next basic attack and its cooldown drops each time he casts, so the auto wind-up is the burst tell rather than the ability cast. Hexplosive Minefield (16s, 900 range) is the ability that actually denies her approach with its slow, and Satchel Charge (20/18/16/14/12s) knocks Annie away as well as relocating him.
audit.corrected: Poke attributed to Bouncing Bomb with its range; the Short Fuse tell and the minefield's approach-denial written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Satchel Charge was labelled 'matchup-defining' with no cooldown anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and Hexplosive Minefield 16s at every rank — those two numbers are the entire step-up schedule against him.
audit.corrected: Both written into breakdown.cooldowns and the do's.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.wave used the generic 'every assassin timer in the game' template.
audit.why: Ziggs is not an assassin and does not punish a shoved wave by diving — he punishes it by clearing from 850 and shoving it back into her tower, which is exactly what the content layer's early section already says.

The kit file carries a 'percentHealth' derived flag on Satchel Charge, and the missing-interactions file therefore claims Ziggs invalidates stacked resistances. Riot's own text for Satchel Charge describes magic damage and a knockback with no percent-health component — the flag is a tooltip-parsing misfire off the turret 'hexplode' clause.
audit.corrected: Deliberately wrote nothing about resistances being invalidated rather than repeat an unverified claim.
